rows.note: Use 資料 as the all-purpose word for facts or knowledge about a topic.

example.english: This information is explained very clearly.
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 zi1 liu6 gong2 dak1 hou2 cing1 co2

rows.note: Use 消息 when the information is news, an update, or something recently learned.

example.english: I just got the information that it will rain tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我啱啱收到消息，聽日會落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 sau1 dou2 siu1 sik1 ting1 jat6 wui5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use 資訊 for information in formal, technical, digital, or institutional contexts rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The information provided by this website is comprehensive.
example.traditional: 呢個網站提供嘅資訊好齊全。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 tai4 gung1 ge3 zi1 seon3 hou2 cai4 cyun4
